exposure: Transversus Abdominis Plane Block (TAPB) combined with patient-controlled intravenous analgesia (PCIA) of nalbuphine and dexmedetomidine
outcome: Visual Analog Scale (VAS) scores at rest and mobilization
cohort: Severely pre-eclamptic parturients who were scheduled for elective cesarean delivery with spinal anesthesia.
finding: Adding Transversus Abdominis Plane Block (TAPB) to patient-controlled intravenous analgesia (PCIA) with nalbuphine and dexmedetomidine significantly improved pain control, enhanced maternal satisfaction, shortened recovery times, and reduced stress responses for severely pre-eclamptic parturients after cesarean delivery.
